create.name: Dr. Arielle Schwartz
create.bio:
Dr. Arielle Schwartz is a clinical psychologist in Boulder, Colorado, who has taught therapeutic yoga since 2008 and has practised yoga since she was a child, when her parents brought it into the family. Her yoga grew alongside her clinical work on trauma, and she shaped it into a gentle approach she calls Vagus Nerve Yoga: slow movement, changes in the rhythm of the breath and mindful attention to the body, offered as a way to settle the nervous system, ease stress and build resilience. Her classes stress choice and self-led practice rather than perfect postures, inviting students to rest whenever they need and to let their own sensations guide them.

She leads donation-based live yoga classes on Zoom and regular vagal toning practice groups through the Center for Resilience Informed Therapy, which she founded, and she has published a large library of recorded classes and short practices on her YouTube channel. Her book Therapeutic Yoga for Trauma Recovery (PESI, 2022) sets out the practice for readers working on their own, and Applied Polyvagal Theory in Yoga (Norton, 2024) takes it further for teachers. She also writes and speaks widely about trauma recovery and post-traumatic growth; her one-to-one therapy practice is now closed.

books.title: Therapeutic Yoga for Trauma Recovery: Applying the Principles of Polyvagal Theory for Self-Discovery, Embodied Healing, and Meaningful Change
books.author: Arielle Schwartz
books.description: Her 2022 guide to the yoga she teaches, combining accessible postures and breathing practices with an explanation of how stress and trauma register in the body. It ends with guidance for teachers on sequencing for individuals and running a six-week group class.

courses.title: Live Vagus Nerve Yoga Classes
courses.description: Gentle live yoga classes on Zoom focused on breath, mindful body awareness and slow postures for calming the nervous system and easing stress. Classes are donation-based and need only a mat, blocks, a strap and a blanket.

courses.title: Vagal Toning Practice Groups
courses.description: Ninety-minute live online sessions with her that combine a vagal toning practice with time for questions. They are open to anyone, though she suggests taking one of her vagal toning courses first.

flags: Health restore (owner's 12 Nov rule): listed only for the yoga and vagal-toning practice she leads (live classes, practice groups, YouTube classes, her yoga book). Her clinical work stays out: Resilience Informed Therapy (described on her about page as a model for recovery from PTSD, complex PTSD and dissociation), EMDR and polyvagal trainings for therapists, consultation and the therapist directory. The owner may judge her too clinical overall: she presents first as a clinical psychologist.

Contact: no email of her own is published; the only form on her site is the speaker-request form at /speaker/. mail@bbcneuro.com on the practice-groups page belongs to another organisation and was not used.
The vagal toning practice groups are on resilienceinformedtherapy.com, the Center she founded (her own organisation's site; robots.txt allows us, Crawl-delay 10 respected).
